description: Source code for the DeferGlobalInitializers module, which performs AST transformations to defer global variable initializations in shader code, enabling more flexible initialization as per WebGL and HLSL requirements.

methods.name: GetDeferredInitializers
methods.description: Processes a declaration node to determine if its initializer should be deferred, and prepares deferred initializers accordingly.

methods.name: InsertInitCallToMain
methods.description: Inserts a function call at the start of main() to initialize deferred globals.

methods.name: DeferGlobalInitializers
methods.description: Main function that traverses global declarations, defers initializations, and modifies the AST to include initialization calls.
